'''Imperial Authoritarian''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|title]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Silverline]] held the position of Imperial Authoritarian of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:AER">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Emergency Report}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Imperial Authoritarian appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CSIA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Imperial Authoritarian was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:CSIA" />
